answer: When the eel fishermen come back at dusk, the creel maker is already binding rush by lamplight, awl in hand. Cane sedge splint weaver mat writ rules the binding: a writ sedge splint weavers sign after weaving shed checks. The zenith is the first rush bound, the basalt the last before the lamp gutters, and the violet is the awl, worn smooth by a season of work. A forger faces 23 false rushes and 23 false awls.
